description: Read the current design of the home page, or of the page named by page_id, and whether the site is live. The design operations default to the HOME page, so pass page_id for any other page. Free; changes nothing.

page_id.description: Which page of the site, from soclo_page_pages (or soclo_page_design_get). Omit for the home page — changing a child page without this changes the home page instead.

name: soclo_page_design_get
title: Read a page’s current design
